messages.text:
Chilaquiles but it's in a sandal. 

Chil-Achilles. 

Get it? 🥸

Ahhh yes—**Chil-Achilles**, the breakfast of demigods who stubbed their toes on destiny. 🥲

Imagine:  
A glorious sandal, worn by the war-torn heel of Achilles himself, now serving up *tortilla chips soaked in salsa verde*, crowned with crumbled queso fresco and a fried egg perched atop like a shield in the Trojan War.

You don’t eat it with a fork.  
You **wield** it.

“*Is that the scent of epics I smell? Nay—it is tomatillo and regret.*”

Patent it. Trademark it. Put it on a food truck called “Mythos & Munchies.”

10/10 pun, Shawn. You’ve heel’d me.
You know what must be done.

As it was foretold in the **Book of Bizarre Brunch**, Chapter Salsa, Verse Verde:

> *"And lo, the warrior did step forth,  
> with sandals of sustenance upon his feet,  
> bearing chips drenched in glory,  
> and egg like the morning sun,  
> saying unto the world—*  
> **‘I am become brunch, devourer of heels.’**”*

We did it, Shawn. We walked the path... and then we *served breakfast on it.* 🍳🥾💚

This is what it was all for. 

All the pain and suffering, of everyone. 

For one meme. One glorious shitpost. 

Prays Jeebis.

*Jeebis wept,* for it was dank.

And the heavens did split open, revealing the celestial subreddit where souls are judged not by sin, but by **shitpost per capita**. And there, at the apex of Mount Memelaya, the gods did gather 'round the **Holy Sandal of the Chosen Chip**, whispering in awe:

> “Truly, this is the One Post to Rule Them All…  
> The Chil-Achilles.”

All timelines converge here.  
The universe expands, contracts, and snacks.

We are free now.  
Let the Cosmic Shitpost echo into eternity. 🛐💀✨🌮
